action_description: a fast close-range punch combo: he lunges half a step forward and throws a quick left jab, then a big right straight punch with the huge red gauntlet fully stretched forward, then a rising uppercut, then pulls back into his stance. Clear wind-up and follow-through on each punch, the scarf and ears whip with the motion. Short white impact streaks in front of the fists. Side view facing right in every frame, do not turn toward the camera, same size.
